The replay read no sleep and planned the roll to miss, so the engine never met Sweet Veil and the views missed it. A Sweet Veil block on a target the move hit means the secondary's sleep was drawn (DESIGN.md R-M11-43, as R-M11-15 for Effect Spore). Minimized from the Nightly battle m8-gen7-doubles-s1752-006
